title: Quiz: Return Values
description: Check your understanding of Return Values.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Java?
questions.explanation: In Java, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What does "return" do?
options: Sends a value back and ends the function
questions.correctAnswer: Sends a value back and ends the function
questions.explanation: Return both produces output and stops execution of that function.

questions.question: True or False: undefined
questions.explanation: This statement is incorrect — review the lesson.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: $return a + b   // hand result to caller
In Java, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
